thread:
alex_k: BigBank POC kickoff in 1hr. Main asks: streaming responses + function/tool calling for account enrichments, structured JSON outputs for downstream systems, and cost sensitivity. Need a quick plan on SDK example, latency/QPS targets, and security questionnaire answers.

maria_p: copying the notes from the call: they want 99.9% p95 < 150ms for short responses (~64 tokens), and sustained 200 QPS for embeddings. Confirming we can do streaming with function calls and structured JSON output schema.

tyler_r: we can. For streaming + functions here's a minimal node example:
```js
const res = await client.responses.stream({
  model: \"redwood-neo-1\",
  input: \"Retrieve account enrichment\",
  stream: true,
  tool_calling: true,
  output_format: { type: \"json_schema\", schema: { id: \"string\", name: \"string\" } }
})
res.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk))
```

samir: also note batching/kv-cache can lower cost. For 200 QPS embeddings we recommend dedicated capacity or reserve a burst pool.

jordan: security Qs: they asked about SAML SSO, audit logs retention, KMS integration. Answer: SSO supported for Dedicated and Private; audit logs available in Console; KMS via customer-managed keys in Private. I'll attach the questionnaire after the call.

alex_k: Pricing q: are we comfortable with pricing for streaming vs non-streaming? They want to compare token-based hosted vs reserved price. @maria_p any guidance?

maria_p: For hosted streaming, show them per-input + per-output token rates. For Dedicated, provide a monthly reserved price + overage per token. I'll pull the price sheet. short note: streaming isn't more expensive per token but reduces latency; batching reduces unit cost.

tyler_r: Edge-case: they want structured output with nested arrays and function returns. Recommend enforcing strict json_schema and using validation on our SDK side. Example response schema:
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"accounts":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"balance":{"type":"number"}}}}}
```

samir: Also highlight graceful fallback: if model exceeds latency we can route to a cheaper variant or fall back to cached prefix. That usually placates infra teams.

deploy-bot: deploy 1768.4567 started by alex_k: /deploy presales/demo-poc in staging

maria_p: I'll send an integration runbook + quickstart SDK snippet to their eng lead. alex_k can you own the security questionnaire follow-up?

alex_k: Yep, I'll take it. I'll post the questionnaire answers here once done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
